prompt: Realistic handheld smartphone mockumentary video, vertical, filmed by a coworker in a modern beauty salon at night. Two real monkeys at a manicure table: Paco, a pale-faced capuchin in a black apron with a white towel on his shoulder, tired and deadpan, holding a cardboard shoebox full of crumpled receipts; and Lola, a small elegant female monkey with golden fur, black dress with white collar, pearl necklace, gold earrings and a black bow, sarcastic and sharp. Spanish from Spain dialogue, natural lip sync. Lola, in a dry female voice, Spain accent: "Paco, eso no son cuentas. Es una caja de zapatos." She holds up her smartphone with the screen facing the camera, keeping it steady and clearly visible: "Mira. Ganaste mil novecientos. Y la manicura rusa te sale a pérdida." Paco pauses, slowly turns and looks straight at the camera, offended, in a tired deep male voice, Spain accent: "¿Y lo de cansadísimo no cuenta?" Deadpan sarcastic humor, quiet salon ambience. The phone screen stays plain white. No music, no subtitles, no text on screen.
